title: What Happens If Solid Wood Furniture Arrives Damaged or Marked? WRYDECO Guide
meta_description: Received a damaged or finish-marked solid wood furniture piece? Learn WRYDECO's 30-day reporting window, store-paid return shipping, and inspection steps.
body_html:
Unpacking a handcrafted solid wood furniture piece should be an exciting moment of home transformation. However, long-distance transit across freight networks carries inevitable logistical risks. Knowing exactly what happens if your order arrives damaged, marked, or defective ensures you can protect your investment calmly and take the right procedural steps.

WRYDECO provides comprehensive protection for freight transit: under our verified refund and return policy, customers have 30 calendar days from the date of delivery to report any item that arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect due to a fulfillment error. For all approved damage or defect claims, WRYDECO covers 100% of return shipping costs and provides explicit written collection instructions. Furthermore, all furniture pieces are protected by a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects in materials and craftsmanship.

What initial freight inspection steps should you perform upon crate arrival?

When your solid wood furniture arrives via motor freight carrier, the external wooden crating serves as the first line of defense. Before signing the carrier delivery receipt or bill of lading (BOL), take three minutes to inspect the outer packaging thoroughly.

Look for broken exterior plywood, fractured reinforcing runners, crushed pallet corners, punctured cardboard wrap, or sheared metal banding. If you observe visible structural damage to the external crate, request that the delivery driver record "Crate Arrived Damaged" directly on the electronic terminal or paper delivery receipt before departure. Photograph the crate from at least two wide angles before unfastening screws or prying open the exterior panels.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860579418.jpg]

Follow these four preliminary freight inspection protocols:

  • Photograph all four exterior sides of the wooden crate before removing packing screws or strapping.
  • Note any visible puncturing, moisture stains, or wood fractures directly on the freight carrier receipt.
  • Open the crate carefully in a clean, dry room using appropriate screwdrivers rather than heavy prybars.
  • Retain all original packaging materials, internal foam corners, and timber braces until inspection is complete.

How do you distinguish between natural timber characteristics and genuine transit damage?

Handcrafted natural hardwood possesses innate organic character that mass-produced plastic laminate or composite particleboard cannot replicate. It is essential to distinguish between natural wood features and actual damage caused during freight transit.

Natural timber characteristics include grain variations, color swirls, minor mineral streaks, sound knots, and medullary rays (silvery flecks running perpendicular to growth rings, especially prominent in oak and ash). These organic traits demonstrate genuine solid timber authenticity and do not compromise structural stability. In contrast, transit damage involves freshly splintered timber, sheared joinery dowels, cracked load-bearing limbs, impact indentations that break the timber surface, or deep surface gouges that scratch through the protective hardwax oil finish down to raw wood fibers.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860612186_2fa155fa-6aa5-4b78-bf0e-03c11df99628.jpg]

Evaluate your furniture surface against these four diagnostic criteria:

  • Natural grain swirls and medullary ray flecks are smooth to the touch under the hardwax oil finish.
  • Transit gouges and impact dents present rough edges, broken wood fibers, or sharp indentation depressions.
  • Hairline seasonal checking along end grain differs from through-cracks caused by excessive mechanical impact.
  • Contact WRYDECO customer support with high-resolution photos if you are uncertain about a specific marking.

What is WRYDECO's 30-calendar-day claim process for damaged or marked furniture?

If your furniture piece arrives with verified freight damage, surface marking, or manufacturing defects, WRYDECO provides an explicit 30-calendar-day reporting window starting from the delivery timestamp recorded by the carrier.

To initiate a claim, email support@wrydeco.com within 30 calendar days of delivery. Include your original order number, delivery date, a brief factual description of the issue, and clear photographs. Please provide:

  • One wide-angle photograph showing the complete furniture unit.
  • One medium-angle photograph showing the affected limb, shelf tier, or panel in context.
  • Two close-up, well-lit macro photographs clearly detailing the scratch, dent, or fractured joint.
  • Photographs of the external packaging and shipping labels showing tracking barcodes.

Our client support team reviews claims within 1 to 2 business days. If approved, WRYDECO provides written instructions and covers the full cost of return shipping or pickup. Please note that returns are not accepted for change of mind, personal aesthetic preference, or customer-ordered dimensional mismatch; return shipping coverage applies strictly to transit damage, manufacturing defects, or fulfillment errors.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860907098.jpg]

Remember these four documentation requirements when submitting your claim:

  • Submit your claim within 30 calendar days of the recorded delivery date to remain fully eligible.
  • Capture macro photos in natural, indirect daylight to show the true depth and texture of any surface marking.
  • Do not attempt permanent DIY glue repairs, chemical sanding, or stripping before our team reviews the evidence.
  • Await official written return instructions from WRYDECO before returning or moving any freight items.

How does WRYDECO resolve verified transit claims (repair, part replacement, or exchange)?

Depending on the nature and severity of the issue, WRYDECO deploys one of three tailored resolution paths designed to restore your piece to flawless condition quickly:

  1. Artisan Surface Care Kit: For superficial finish rubs or micro-abrasions that do not penetrate the timber, WRYDECO provides an authentic matching touch-up kit containing zero-VOC plant-based hardwax oil and fine finishing pads. Because our finishes are non-film-forming penetrating oils, blending a localized area takes only five minutes and restores complete sheen uniformity without stripping.
  2. Modular Component Replacement: Because WRYDECO tree shelves and modular casegoods utilize precision-joined structural sections, an isolated damaged branch limb or shelf platform can be replaced independently. WRYDECO master craftspeople handcraft a matching replacement component with pre-drilled internal fittings and express-ship it to your door.
  3. Full Return and Re-Craft: If the primary trunk column suffers severe structural fracture or catastrophic freight crushing, WRYDECO coordinates full freight pickup at zero cost to you and initiates priority re-crafting or a 100% refund processed within 2 business days of return inspection.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305861234778.jpg]

Note these four policy safeguards governing repairs and refunds:

  • Standard shipping takes approximately 15 to 20 business days for crafting plus 3 to 5 business days transit (18 to 25 business days estimated total).
  • Order cancellation or detail modification is 100% free within the first 6 hours following order placement (Golden Window).
  • The 1-year limited warranty covers defects in materials and craftsmanship under normal indoor residential use.
  • Maintain indoor relative humidity between 40% and 60% and clean with dry microfiber cloths to protect solid timber longevity.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I do if the delivery driver refuses to wait while I inspect the crate?

If the freight driver cannot wait for complete uncrating, immediately inspect the exterior surfaces of the wooden crate. If any puncture, crushed edge, or broken runner is visible, write "Crate Damaged - Subject to Concealed Damage Inspection" next to your signature. If the driver insists on immediate departure without notation, take timestamped photos of the crate on the pallet before moving it inside.

How long do I have to report concealed damage discovered after unboxing?

WRYDECO allows a full 30 calendar days from delivery to inspect your piece and submit a damage claim. However, we strongly recommend unpacking and examining your furniture within the first 48 hours so our artisan team can expedite replacement parts or touch-up materials without delay.

Will a minor scratch require returning the entire 150-pound bookcase?

No. Because WRYDECO finishes furniture with penetrating zero-VOC hardwax oils rather than synthetic plastic coatings, minor surface scuffs can be polished and seamlessly re-oiled in minutes using our artisan care kit. If a specific branch limb is gouged, we ship a precision-matched replacement limb without requiring you to repack the central trunk.

Who pays for shipping if the item must be returned for replacement?

For all approved damage, defect, or fulfillment error claims within the 30-day reporting window, WRYDECO covers 100% of return freight shipping and provides complete collection instructions. Customers are never charged return fees for transit damage.
